claims.text: The hotel sits directly on Lake Ceresio, also called Lake Lugano.

findings.quote: Welcome to the Hotel Splendide Royal, situated on the shores of Lake Lugano.

claims.text: The hotel is a short distance from Lugano's city centre.

findings.quote: accoglie gli ospiti a breve distanza dal centro cittadino

claims.text: The city centre, boutiques, cultural sites and main attractions are a few minutes away.

findings.quote: comodità di raggiungere in pochi minuti il centro, le boutique, i luoghi culturali e le principali attrazioni della città
findings.note: all four items, a few minutes

claims.text: The room types are meant to suit couples, family holidays or business stays.

findings.quote: Le diverse tipologie consentono di scegliere la sistemazione più adatta a un viaggio di coppia, a una vacanza in famiglia o a un soggiorno di lavoro.

claims.text: The hotel belongs to The Leading Hotels of the World, Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Virtuoso and Swiss Historic Hotels.

findings.quote: fa parte di **The Leading Hotels of the World**, **Swiss Deluxe Hotels**, **Virtuoso** e **Swiss Historic Hotels**

claims.text: The spa has an outdoor terrace looking out over the lake.

findings.quote: La terrazza esterna permette di prolungare l’esperienza di benessere ammirando il paesaggio del lago.
findings.note: spa outdoor terrace with lake view

claims.text: The hotel's restaurants are La Veranda and I Due Sud.

findings.quote: La proposta gastronomica comprende il ristorante **La Veranda** e **I Due Sud**

claims.text: The hotel serves a traditional English tea.

findings.quote: partake in the **timeless tradition of English tea**

claims.text: On summer evenings, pizza is served on the terrace.

findings.quote: bask in the warmth of a summer evening with a **pizza on the terrace.**

claims.text: The hotel offers a candlelit gourmet dinner.

findings.quote: la **cena gastronomica a lume di candela**

claims.text: The hotel has bars, terraces and event spaces.

findings.quote: Bar, terrazze e spazi dedicati agli eventi completano l’offerta dell’hotel.

claims.text: The hotel is a historic Belle Epoque palace that first opened as a hotel in 1887.

findings.quote: Lo storico palazzo Belle Époque, inaugurato come albergo nel 1887
findings.note: historic Belle Epoque palace, opened as hotel 1887

claims.text: I Due Sud holds one star in the Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026.

findings.quote: **I Due Sud**, premiato con una Stella nella Guida Michelin Svizzera 2026

claims.text: The Splendide Lifestyle Spa has a panoramic pool, a sauna, a Turkish bath, a gym and treatments.

findings.quote: La **Splendide Lifestyle Spa** completa il soggiorno con piscina panoramica, sauna, bagno turco, palestra, trattamenti e spazi dedicati al relax.

claims.text: Lake Ceresio and the mountains around Lugano can be seen from the panoramic rooms, the terraces and many public areas.

findings.quote: Dalle camere panoramiche, dalle terrazze e da numerosi ambienti comuni è possibile ammirare il Ceresio e le montagne che circondano Lugano.

claims.text: The suites measure roughly 60 to 85 square metres and can sleep up to four guests.

findings.quote: Con superfici comprese indicativamente tra 60 e 85 m², offrono spazi ampi e distinti, capaci di accogliere fino a quattro ospiti
findings.note: roughly 60-85 m2, up to four guests

claims.text: Not every room faces the lake: rooms and suites have either a lake view or a park view, so ask for a lake view when booking.

findings.quote: Le camere e le suite dello Splendide Royal sono ambienti eleganti e riservati, con vista sul lago oppure affacciati sul parco.
findings.note: lake or park view; booking advice is not a factual element

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the central location.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
